question: How many times did India win the women's World Cup in cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Once__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **eleven World Cups** that have been contested so far have taken place in **five nations.**
 
• India has won the ICC Women’s Cricket World **Cup once — in 2025.**
 
• India has reached the final three times — in 2005, 2017, and 2025.
 
• 2005: Lost to Australia by 98 runs.
 
• 2017: Lost to England by 9 runs.
 
• 2025: Won against South Africa by 52 runs.
 
• With six titles, Australia has had the greatest success of any nation.
 
• **New Zealand** only won** one title**, while **England won four.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Veteran Indian women's cricketer Mithali Raj **has amassed** 10,000 international runs **across all cricket formats.
 
• She became the **first Indian woman** to achieve this feat.
 
• She also passed the** milestone of 10,000 runs** for a** female cricket player** internationally.
 
• On **June 8, 2022, **Mithali Raj declared her** retirement** from all forms of cricket.
